name: OMTech 40W CO₂ (K40 class)
tagline: The classic budget CO₂ : powerful but expects you to tinker
tldr: The modern evolution of the famous K40. Real CO₂ cutting power at the lowest CO₂ price point. Excellent value if you enjoy upgrading and fixing things. Wrong choice if you want plug-and-play out of the box.

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm acrylic

cannot: Very thick materials in one pass

pros: Lowest-cost entry to real CO₂ cutting
Cuts acrylic and wood diode lasers struggle with
Huge mod community (LightBurn, air assist, better exhaust)
Parts and tubes are cheap to replace
Can produce sellable products once dialed in
cons: Stock exhaust, bed, and controller often need upgrades
Safety and ventilation are your responsibility
Quality control varies : some units need alignment work
Not enclosed on most models : louder and smokier
beginnerNotes: Do not buy a K40-class machine if you want to unbox and go. Budget an extra $100–200 for exhaust hose, air assist, and possibly a controller upgrade. Watch a full setup video before ordering.
proTips: Install LightBurn and a Mini Gerbil or similar board if you outgrow stock software. Replace the stock exhaust fan immediately. Keep a fire extinguisher nearby : CO₂ cuts combustible materials.
primaryUse: Budget CO₂ laser cutting and engraving for makers willing to modify and maintain their machine.
mainObjective: Budget CO₂ cutting for makers willing to upgrade and maintain
